parameters.query: SELECT id, active FROM users WHERE id = $1 LIMIT 1;
SELECT phone, first_name, last_name FROM contacts WHERE id = $1 AND is_archived = false LIMIT 1;
SELECT pgp_sym_decrypt(api_key_encrypted, $1) AS api_key, config FROM integrations WHERE provider = 'vapi' AND is_active = true AND api_key_encrypted IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: Look Up Vapi Integration
nodes.notes: Requires INTEGRATIONS_ENCRYPTION_KEY set as an n8n environment variable — same value used by Integrations.json when the key was saved.
